title: GACL Showcases its Cutting-Edge Industrial Chemicals at ChemExpo Exhibition, Mumbai

blocks.text: GACL Showcases its Cutting-Edge Industrial Chemicals at ChemExpo Exhibition, Mumbai

blocks.html: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL) proudly presented its latest innovations in industrial chemicals at the prestigious ChemExpo Exhibition held in Mumbai. The event served as a platform for industry leaders to explore advancements in chemical manufacturing and foster collaborative opportunities.

During the exhibition, Shri Pankaj Joshi, IAS, Additional Chief Secretary to Chief Minister, honored GACL’s booth with his presence. He was warmly welcomed by Shri Sanjay Bhatt, Company Secretary & CGM (Legal, CC & CSR), GACL, who presented him with a beautiful bouquet of flowers.

Over the course of the two-day event, numerous industry stalwarts visited the GACL booth, engaging in insightful discussions and exchanging perspectives on the future of chemical manufacturing. GACL’s senior-level executives and employees were also present, showcasing the company’s commitment to excellence and innovation.
It was a knowledge-filled experience connecting with fellow industry leaders and sharing insights into the future of chemical manufacturing.
GACL extends its sincere gratitude to all the visitors who took the time to explore its booth and looks forward to continued collaboration and innovation within the chemical industry.
